characters.name: JÄNES JUKU
characters.description: Väike valge jänes pikkade roosade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti. Tal on suured rõõmsad silmad ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIND LIISA
characters.description: Väike sinine laululind, erkpunase rinnaga, pisike kollane nokk. Tal on väikesed säravad silmad ja sõbralik naeratav näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Aed
locations.description: A bright, sunny, whimsical garden. The ground is covered in lush green grass. There are several patches of small, simple, colorful spring flowers (yellow, red, blue, purple) scattered gently. A few friendly looking small bushes are in the background. The sky is a clear, cheerful blue with a few soft white clouds. Gentle sunlight illuminates the scene. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Jänes Juku, a small white rabbit with long pink ears and a blue vest, sits happily on the lush green grass in a bright, sunny garden. Lind Liisa, a small blue bird with a red chest, is perched gently on a small colorful spring flower nearby. Both are looking around with friendly, curious expressions. The garden has various colorful spring flowers and bushes, under a clear blue sky with soft white clouds, illuminated by gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, and Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, are standing together on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. They are both looking down at the ground, pointing with a paw and a wing respectively, at the many vibrant patches of colorful spring flowers (yellow, red, blue, purple) scattered around them. Their expressions are full of wonder and joy. The garden features bushes in the background, a clear blue sky, and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, and Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, are standing close together on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. Juku looks at Liisa with an excited smile, and Liisa looks back at Juku, chirping happily. They both have a thoughtful yet enthusiastic expression, ready for an adventure. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are visible around them, under a clear blue sky with soft white clouds, illuminated by gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, is kneeling on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. He is gently holding a bright red spring flower in his paws, smiling proudly. Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, is flying just above Juku, looking at the red flower with interest. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are scattered in the background. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, is delicately holding a vibrant yellow leaf in her beak. She is standing on the lush green grass in the sunny garden, presenting the leaf with a cheerful expression. Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, is kneeling beside her, looking at the yellow leaf with an approving smile. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are visible around them. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, is using his paws to gather a small pile of fresh green grass on the lush green ground in the sunny garden. Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, is helping by gently pulling small blades of grass with her beak and adding them to the pile. Both characters are focused and working together, smiling. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are in the background. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, is standing on the lush green grass in the sunny garden, holding a beautiful soft blue feather in her beak. She looks very pleased with her find. Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, is sitting nearby, admiring the blue feather with wide eyes and a happy smile. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are around them. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, and Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, are carefully arranging their collected natural treasures into a colorful circle on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. They are placing the red flower, yellow leaf, green grass, and blue feather in an artful pattern. Juku is using his paws and Liisa her beak. Both are focused and collaborative. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are in the background. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, and Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, are standing proudly next to their completed colorful 'picture' on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. The picture is a beautiful circle made from the red flower, yellow leaf, green grass, and blue feather. Both characters are looking at their creation with wide, happy smiles. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are in the background. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.

Jänes Juku, wearing his blue vest, is giving a joyful high-five with his paw to Lind Liisa, the small blue bird with a red chest, who is chirping happily. They are standing beside their colorful nature art on the lush green grass in the sunny garden. Both have big, delighted smiles, celebrating their achievement. Colorful spring flowers and bushes are visible around them. Clear blue sky with soft white clouds and gentle sunlight. Cartoon style.
